mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 0.5% indicates monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 0.5% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns through stronger corporate earnings expectations over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the joint increase in PAYEMS and HOUST does not produce significantly positive 60-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) triggers monetary policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods with CPIAUCSL rise > 0.3% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, signaling potential economic contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in INDPRO < 100 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in declining UNRATE periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000 indicates weakening consumer demand for residential construction, signaling reduced economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in HOUST < 1000 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or the joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce significantly negative 5-day returns (t-test p > 0.05).
